title: Generic EIP-712 field walker gated by a registry-known-domain omission filter (Bloom twin) and empty-domain refusal
threat: Any typed-data request for a dapp without a curated ERC-7730 EIP-712 descriptor is signable only as RAW32 (blind); users are pushed to the worst tier precisely for long-tail dapps, and a hostile companion can strip the descriptor from a registry-known domain only if there is a generic path — so the two must land together.
proposal: (1) Build a 16 KiB Bloom of every registry-declared (chain_id, verifyingContract, primaryType-hash) tuple (same dbgen pipeline and 25% occupancy cap as known_calls); a kind-2/3 request whose domain is Bloom-positive but carries no bound descriptor hard-refuses ('7730 eip712 proof needed'), exactly mirroring the contract-call filter. (2) For Bloom-negative domains, add a structural walker: render EVERY leaf (no 'show more' skipping), label by field name from the companion-supplied type string whose hash the device recomputes into the EIP-712 typeHash (so names are bound to the signed hash), refuse arrays-of-arrays, nested EIP712Domain members, missing chainId/verifyingContract, non-UTF-8 strings; banner '! NO INTENT / structure only'; final Eip712Final ERC-8213 page; chord/hold after last page. (3) Keep RAW32 (CS-01) off.
rationale: Trezor and Ledger both render arbitrary EIP-712 generically; pq1 refuses, which is sound but drives long-tail dapps to RAW32. The walker is NOT semantic clear-signing (no intent claim) but is strictly better than a 32-byte hash, and the Bloom twin preserves the 'registry-known shape either clear-signs or refuses' contract for typed data, which today holds only for contract calls.
repo_evidence: secure/src/nsc/cmd_sign_offchain.rs:479-487 ('7730 bundle fail' — kinds 2/3 require a descriptor)
pqsigner-erc7730/src/known_calls.rs (contract-call Bloom only; grep -i eip712|typed → empty)
proto/src/lib.rs:1271 MAX_OFFCHAIN_EIP712_ENCODED_DATA_LEN=512 (bound already exists for a walker)
gap listed as untracked in inventory (adjacent #381, #534)
vendor_precedent: Trezor core/src/apps/ethereum/sign_typed_data.py:69-140 (field-by-field hashing with type validation), 293-296 (nested EIP712Domain rejected), 407-426 (empty-domain warning), 491-566 (_validate_value); Ledger EIP-712 filtering.
risks: Owner decision: curated-only stance vs structural display. Field names come from the companion's type string — bound to the hash but still attacker-chosen vocabulary (e.g. a field named 'refund' that is actually 'spender'); the '! NO INTENT' banner and danger chrome (CS-02) must make that explicit. Page budget (31) caps struct size — refuse, never truncate.
